item.title: Measles is back, and it’s a dire warning against shrinking the U.S. government
item.description: The U.S. losing its measles elimination status is likely not the last direct consequence of the huge cuts to the government. Sometimes, you really don’t know what you’ve got ‘til it’s gone. Take, for instance, the United States’ measles elimination status. Formally rescinded this week, after a 26-year run, the Pan American Health Organization’s new determination is about to make a lot of people realize what a quiet miracle it was to never have to think about measles....
